lesson_intro.heading: Cloud Engineer · PM-3.3
lesson_intro.board_text:
Application Load Balancer
Finova · finova-dev · ap-south-1

Why before how:
Users hit a stable entry — not one fragile instance IP.

Mental model:
ALB distributes to healthy targets across AZs.

You will: watch → learn → practice one navigation.

whiteboard_intro.board_text:
